title: Generated AC1024 inline TABLECONTENT specification vectors
scope: Correct the AC1024 generated TABLE frame's reference roles and aligned handle-stream bound, then run the ODA-shaped inline TABLECONTENT and malformed-reference controls.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
constraints: The R2010+ TABLE prefix carries an unknown soft pointer whose default is NULL.
TABLECONTENT is inline in the R24 TABLE entity and omits a second common OBJECT header.
CadValue type 2 is a BD double; type 64 Object ID is an H soft pointer.
The bounded entity handle stream begins at the byte-aligned post-string boundary; its bit length includes byte-alignment bits.

generatedControls: The AC1024 TABLE BLOCK_RECORD reference is encoded with the required hard-pointer role, and the stream bound includes its aligned byte size.
The generated inline TABLECONTENT profile checks name, description, column/cell values, the following body boundary, and correct hard-pointer roles for field/block references.
Malformed role, truncation, invalid-count, and incomplete-content cases verify atomic prefix retention or rejection as appropriate.
implementation.command: cmake -S . -B build-gcc -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 && cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests -j2 && ctest --test-dir build-gcc --output-on-failure -R '^libdxfrw_ac1024_table_content_spec_vectors$'
implementation.result: Reconfigured and built with project warning policy; 1 of 1 focused CTests passed.

fixtureDisposition: Vectors are authored in memory. No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
qualificationBoundary: This verifies a specification-shaped parser/vector contract only. It does not provide an AutoCAD producer witness, qualify the observed AC1024 source-profile string layout, establish strict TABLE output/readback, native appearance, or broader AC1024 support. P5-D remains open for its producer-bound profile.
